paper.title: A Dirac-Frenkel-Onsager principle: Instantaneous residual minimization with gauge momentum for nonlinear parametrizations of PDE solutions

claims.paper_statement: DFO injects momentum only in Gram-matrix nullspace directions while preserving instantaneous residual minimization.
claims.scope: Fixed 2 x 3 linear fixture; no nonlinear PDE or theorem verification.

claims.paper_statement: Proposition A.1 recovers the exact wave crossing at rho=0 for lambda=(1-exp(-2/tau))^-1.
claims.scope: Four finite tau values; no wave PDE solve or continuous-time proof check.

claims.paper_statement: DFO reduces error over standard Dirac-Frenkel on three low-dimensional PDE benchmarks.
claims.scope: No benchmark implementation or result artifact.

claims.paper_statement: DFO improves error and RDFO reduces runtime on a five-dimensional Fokker-Planck problem.
claims.scope: No Fokker-Planck implementation, checkpoint, or runtime artifact.

claims.paper_statement: Algorithm 1 uses truncated SVD, EMA momentum, nullspace projection, and ordered parameter update.
claims.scope: Source/contract pinned; no independent Algorithm 1 implementation.

publication_policy: Publish only the bounded toy audit with explicit limits; do not claim PDE, runtime, theorem, or author endorsement evidence.
